cases.assertion_intent: Public Go library contract exports succeed, JSON matches the authoritative service.Snapshot(), and both JSON and JavaScript preserve complete byte-stable output with a trailing newline.
cases.adaptation: The Go project is a library and has retired its command executable. Preserve successful contract export through public service.AsJSON()/AsJS() instead of a subprocess: verify the real JSON against service.Snapshot(), verify repeated exports byte-for-byte including their trailing newline, and retain TestRemainingSurfaceGeneratedJS for compiler-owned JavaScript values and regeneration provenance. Original upstream subprocess inputs, assertions and source remain unchanged; this native API adaptation does not claim execution of the unchanged Python CLI assertions.
cases.oracle: Actual public service.Snapshot(), successful service.AsJSON()/AsJS() output, exact repeated bytes and trailing newlines; JavaScript semantic values are additionally checked by TestRemainingSurfaceGeneratedJS.
